bio: This restaurant brings a slice of Asia all the way to the peaceful Dutch countryside. Red lanterns, Buddha statues, a dragon boat in the middle of the dining space… It's almost as if you have been whisked away to the Far East. Adding to the atmosphere, the host enthusiastically presents each dish. Asian fusion cuisine is interpreted with a modern twist, often incorporating local ingredients, but always staying true to its authentic spirit. Think braised MRIJ beef sirloin in a punchy massaman curry with the perfect dose of chilli. Red Chilli will definitely spice up your evening!...
